nodes.text: HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms. It can cause severe symptoms in young children, elderly & immunocompromised people. Common symptoms: cough, fever, nasal congestion & difficulty breathing.🦠#HMPV #HealthAlert #ViralInfection #Virus
